name: Multifaceted Collection
description: The Multifaceted Collection is a preference dataset containing 192k combinations of values across 65k user instructions, designed to improve large language models' alignment to diverse user preferences via system message generalization.
reputation: A newly introduced preference dataset for alignment research, with growing interest but not yet established as a widely adopted community benchmark.
notes: Dataset enables training of models to generalize to diverse system messages reflecting user preferences.
